title: Every session without --effort ran with thinking off
observed: harness.New turned an unset ThinkingLevel into "off" (pi's default), so Opus 4.8 ran with thinking disabled and Opus 5.5 was pinned to the lowest effort; Claude Code's effortLevel setting was parsed but never used; resumed sessions kept a saved "off"
expected: Unset level: adaptive thinking with the effort left to the model; effortLevel from Claude Code settings applies to Claude models; --effort or the setting also applies on resume
